location_policy: Coordinates identify maintained market reference points. User coordinates are compared in the browser and are never sent, stored, logged, or added to URLs.
source_policy: Official dated prices and source-linked country snapshots are shown with their original dates and coverage. Historical records can be used explicitly for labelled planning estimates; no price is a guaranteed station quote.
